content: Lock-before-request pattern: disable the button synchronously in the click handler (before any await/network call) and gate on an in-flight flag, not just the async mutation's own pending state, since there's a window between click and the state update propagating where a second click can race through. Re-enable on both success and failure (finally block); add a timeout/fallback re-enable so a silently-hung request doesn't permanently disable the control.
